Rollable ribbon, high-count, micro and indoor cable that run late elsewhere, built to order from tier 1 manufacturers on Fujikura preform glass. 6 to 8 weeks standard, 2 to 3 weeks by air, and up to 10 weeks for high-count or custom builds.

A second source is the supplier you call when your usual one is slow, short or stretched on a spec. Vocom builds to order, so there is no shelf to run out of. Send the spec, get a price and a delivery date, and ship against it. Orders can be split across ship dates so cable lands as your customers need it.

No. Vocom is build-to-order with no US warehouse. Standard lead time is 6 to 8 weeks, expedited air freight is 2 to 3 weeks, and high-count or custom builds take up to 10 weeks.
Can you be a second source for specs my supplier is slow on?
Yes. Rollable ribbon, high-count, micro and indoor plenum cable are the specs most often quoted in months elsewhere. Send the spec and we return a price and a delivery date.
What should I send to get a quote?
Fiber count, fiber type, construction, jacket rating (OFNP, OFNR or LSZH), footage, needed-by date and destination. Any spec can be built to order as a custom build.
Can orders be split across ship dates?
Yes. Large orders are commonly split into tranches so cable arrives against your customers' build phases instead of sitting in your yard.
Where can I find catalog information?
The Resources page has our fiber optic cable catalog with counts, specs and how to order. For anything outside it, send the spec and we will quote it.
Need a Spec Your Supplier Cannot Fill?
Fiber count, jacket, rating and needed-by date, send it and we will quote it as a build-to-order.

pages.title: Indoor Fiber Optic Cable, OFNP and OFNR | Vocom
pages.description: Indoor fiber optic cable in OFNP plenum and OFNR riser ratings: mini cable, rollable ribbon and data center cable, built to order in 6 to 8 weeks.
texts: Indoor Fiber Optic Cable in OFNP Plenum and OFNR Riser Ratings

Mini cable, rollable ribbon, armored drop and data center cable for in-building runs, built to order to the rating your inspector expects. 6 to 8 weeks standard, 2 to 3 weeks by air, and up to 10 weeks for custom builds.
Need a different rating? We also build to custom order.

OFNP is plenum rated, for air handling spaces. OFNR is riser rated, for vertical runs between floors. The rating follows the pathway and the authority inspecting the installation has the final say, so it belongs on the purchase order rather than being assumed.
Mini cable, rollable ribbon, armored indoor drop, MPO trunks and patch cords
OFNP plenum, OFNR riser and LSZH
1F to 12F, spiral armor, rodent and crush protection
MPO and MTP trunks, harness breakouts, cassettes and patch cords
6 to 8 weeks standard, 2 to 3 weeks by air, up to 10 weeks for custom builds
From a single drop to a data hall backbone
Low counts for in-building runs, high counts where pathway space is the constraint. Specified per route and supplied to order.
Browse indoor and data center products
Why source indoor cable through Vocom
Build-to-order: rating, count and jacket specified to your pathway, not off a fixed shelf.
Rated to the pathway: OFNP, OFNR or LSZH stated on the order, not assumed.
Lead times that hold: 6 to 8 weeks standard, while indoor and high-count cable is quoted in months across much of the market.
What is the difference between OFNP and OFNR?

OFNP is plenum rated for air handling spaces. OFNR is riser rated for vertical runs between floors. Plenum is the stricter rating, and the inspecting authority decides which one applies to your pathway.
Which indoor cables do you supply?

Mini cable in 8F and 12F with 3.0mm OD and OFNP rating, indoor rollable ribbon from 12F to 864F in plenum and riser ratings, armored indoor drop, and MPO and MTP trunks and patch cords for the data hall.
Can you supply high-count indoor cable?
Yes. Indoor rollable ribbon runs from 12F to 864F with plenum and riser options, built to order. For other counts, send the spec and we will quote it as a custom build.
6 to 8 weeks from PO, 2 to 3 weeks expedited by air, and up to 10 weeks for custom builds.
What should I put on the order?
Fiber count, fiber type, construction, rating (OFNP, OFNR or LSZH), outer diameter if the pathway is tight, footage and needed-by date.
Need an Indoor Cable Built to Your Exact Rating?
Fiber count, jacket, rating and connector, we can source and build any indoor fiber optic cable to match your spec.
